description: This file defines a class 'AdminReviewMenuConfigurator' which implements menu configuration logic for the OrangeHRM Performance module, specifically for administrative review menus. It modifies the screen to override the default view for performance review search.

classes.name: AdminReviewMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class responsible for configuring the menu for admin review in the Performance module, overriding screen settings as needed.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the method to set the current module screen to 'searchEvaluatePerformanceReview' for the Performance menu.
